purpose: Future-reference research knowledge; no causal or risk ranking inferred
record_grain: One scoped claim/analysis or source definition, not one independent study
blank_semantics: Not extracted or not applicable; never a zero effect

records.agent: Total HAP mass and eight other pollutant totals
records.cancer_evidence: Inventory is not a cancer study. Food and Kindred Products contributes 64.32% of total HAP mass; dry-mill ethanol 6.36%.
records.iowa_evidence: 283 Iowa Title V facility rows; appendix HAP sum 5483.81 tons; rounded report 5484
records.facility_if_any: 283 DNR inventory IDs; see companion full inventory
records.limitations: No mobile/biogenic/nonpoint sources. HAP includes noncarcinogens and mixtures. Pollutant columns overlap. Search metadata incorrectly says 2021. PDF says tons without defining ton basis.
records.exposure_measure: Reported annual emissions mass; tons/year as labeled; ton basis not specified in PDF
records.allowed_inference: Identify covered facilities and investigate actual pollutant-specific historical emissions
records.prohibited_inference: Rank cancer risk from total HAP mass or treat annual emissions as personal dose

records.cancer_evidence: Permit establishes a solvent process, not cancer incidence.
records.iowa_evidence: DNR final permit describes hexane extraction and NESHAP Subpart GGGG records
records.facility_if_any: Facility in permit 11-TV-004R2; retain original permit identifier
records.limitations: Permitted throughput and limits are not actual emissions or measured workplace concentration.
records.allowed_inference: Establish that this process uses hexane
records.prohibited_inference: Infer actual dose or cancer excess from a permit

records.cancer_evidence: EPA IRIS: inadequate information to assess carcinogenic potential; peripheral neuropathy is key noncancer endpoint.
records.iowa_evidence: Iowa solvent-extraction sector present; individual n-hexane composition must be verified
records.limitations: Individual chemical and commercial solvent mixtures differ; not proof of safety.
records.allowed_inference: Distinguish established neurotoxicity from inadequate cancer evidence
records.prohibited_inference: Call all reported hexane an established human carcinogen or declare cancer risk zero

records.cancer_evidence: EPA PPRTV lists suggestive evidence of carcinogenic potential for commercial hexane.
records.iowa_evidence: Relevant only if Iowa solvent formulation matches assessed mixture
records.limitations: Animal-based mixture assessment; composition and route matter. Not equivalent to n-hexane.
records.allowed_inference: Keep mixture-specific hazard separate from n-hexane
records.prohibited_inference: Convert mixture hazard to a named Iowa facility's cancer rate

records.cancer_evidence: Enforcement notice does not evaluate cancer.
records.iowa_evidence: EPA historical notice explicitly identifies hexane extraction at Mason City
records.facility_if_any: AG Processing, Mason City; historical notice
records.data_period: Historical archived enforcement notice; not current status
records.limitations: Spill-response/oil-release matter. Source has a storage-capacity typo that is not reproduced.
records.allowed_inference: Confirm historical process and regulatory event
records.prohibited_inference: Interpret a spill-plan matter as cancer causation

records.process: Dry-mill addition to wet milling and boilers
records.cancer_evidence: Permit clearinghouse has no worker or community cancer outcome.
records.iowa_evidence: EPA RBLC documents an ADM Cedar Rapids project
records.limitations: Project emission increases or limits are not actual annual emissions.
records.allowed_inference: Reconstruct historical process changes
records.prohibited_inference: Treat permitted project emissions as measured dose

records.cancer_evidence: EPA legacy IRIS B2 probable human carcinogen classification based on animal evidence.
records.iowa_evidence: Agent is relevant to Iowa biofuel inventory follow-up; source-specific chemical mass required
records.limitations: Classification framework/date must be retained. Beverage alcohol evidence is not an outdoor plant-vapor exposure estimate.
records.allowed_inference: Flag acetaldehyde for chemical-specific exposure assessment
records.prohibited_inference: Equate beverage ethanol consumption with a plant neighbor's inhaled acetaldehyde dose

records.cancer_evidence: Historical air-quality violation allegations; no epidemiology.
records.iowa_evidence: EPA March 2012 notice alleges violations during 2007-2011
records.limitations: Allegation status and period must be preserved. Not current emissions or cancer findings.
records.allowed_inference: Document a dated pollution-control concern
records.prohibited_inference: Attribute Muscatine cancer cases to the facility from this notice

records.agent: Process emissions; exact original-order speciation not recovered
records.cancer_evidence: Consent order is not a cancer study.
records.iowa_evidence: DNR confirms fees for 2021/2022, permit information, required facility changes and $10000 penalty
records.limitations: Full original consent order not retrieved. Secondary ninefold/27-fold claims are not independently verified in this corpus.
records.allowed_inference: Establish DNR-confirmed order requirements
records.prohibited_inference: Present unverified exceedance multiples as original-order findings

records.cancer_evidence: Measured-concentration-based upper-bound lifetime screening risks; not observed cancers.
records.iowa_evidence: 2021 five-site Iowa monitoring: highest formaldehyde estimate about 50/million Davenport; acetaldehyde 11.2/million Clinton
records.facility_if_any: Des Moines; Cedar Rapids; Clinton; Davenport; Muscatine
records.limitations: Assumes lifetime exposure to annual concentration; sparse sites; atmospheric secondary formation; report classifications are historical.
records.allowed_inference: Describe measured concentrations and the report's screening assumptions
records.prohibited_inference: Call these observed cases or assign them to one nearby industrial source

records.cancer_evidence: Coverage record; no cancer endpoint.
records.iowa_evidence: 2026 plan states four current carbonyl sites: two Des Moines, one Cedar Rapids, one Clinton. Cedar Rapids also canister VOC sampling.
records.facility_if_any: McKinley Academy Cedar Rapids; Des Moines; Clinton
records.limitations: Network status is not 2021 measurement coverage. No federal minimum toxics sites. Search metadata incorrectly says 2025.
records.population_scope: Current Iowa ambient monitoring sites described in plan
records.allowed_inference: Use four-site count for 2026 plan rather than older five/three descriptions
records.prohibited_inference: Infer statewide absence of toxic exposure from sparse monitoring or criteria AQI

records.cancer_evidence: Overall cancer mortality association not statistically significant.
records.iowa_evidence: Not Iowa-specific
records.facility_if_any: UFCW cohort; facility names not used as Iowa records
records.limitations: 30411 poultry vs16405 nonpoultry food workers; limited smoking/alcohol adjustment; union cohort and employment-history limitations.
records.study_design: Historical cohort; adjusted Cox comparison with nonpoultry food workers
records.allowed_inference: Report overall null-compatible result with period-specific findings
records.prohibited_inference: Apply estimate to Iowa residents or state all poultry workers have a fixed cancer excess

records.cancer_evidence: Elevated cancer-mortality estimates in selected hiring periods.
records.iowa_evidence: Not Iowa-specific
records.data_period: Pre1960 and1980-1989 hiring strata; follow-up through2019
records.limitations: Subgroups in an overall null-compatible cohort; same confounding/generalizability limitations. Do not treat as independent study.
records.allowed_inference: Preserve era-specific associations and overall estimate together
records.prohibited_inference: Pool subgroups as independent studies or claim identified causal agent

records.cancer_evidence: Several cancer-mortality excesses in historical cohort.
records.iowa_evidence: Not an Iowa plant cohort
records.limitations: No adjustment for tobacco, alcohol or diet; historical exposures; site-specific estimates not extracted here.
records.allowed_inference: Generate job/agent-specific follow-up questions
records.prohibited_inference: Attribute cancers at a named Iowa employer using this cohort

records.cancer_evidence: Overall lung association nonsignificant; highest cumulative category elevated.
records.iowa_evidence: European evidence, not Iowa-specific
records.limitations: Case-control exposure assessment; smoking-adjusted but residual confounding/multiple exposure categories possible.
records.allowed_inference: Retain exposure-level distinction and geographic scope
records.prohibited_inference: Treat all meat-worker occupations as identical measured exposure

records.cancer_evidence: Borderline glioma association compatible with null.
records.iowa_evidence: Includes Iowa with Michigan,Minnesota,Wisconsin; not an Iowa-only effect
records.limitations: 27cases/21controls in occupation group; many comparisons; broad job proxies; no specific agent established.
records.study_design: Upper Midwest Health Study population-based case-control
records.population_scope: Nonmetropolitan adults in four Midwest states including Iowa
records.allowed_inference: Flag exploratory occupational association
records.prohibited_inference: Call result statistically conclusive or assign it to a particular plant

records.cancer_evidence: Iowa glioma case-control study generated multiple occupational/industrial associations.
records.iowa_evidence: 375 Iowa cases and2434 controls
records.data_period: Publication2001; source-specific case ascertainment dates require full-paper extraction
records.limitations: Many occupational comparisons; hypothesis-generating; no individual agent dose.
records.allowed_inference: Locate original table for industry-specific follow-up
records.prohibited_inference: Use a broad job category to establish facility causation

records.cancer_evidence: Elevated renal-cell-carcinoma association; imprecise.
records.iowa_evidence: Iowa population-based case-control:406 cases2434 controls
records.limitations: Wide confidence interval; many job comparisons; no individual ingredient/process exposure.

records.cancer_evidence: Respiratory hazard evaluation; no cancer outcome.

records.cancer_evidence: Improved measured exposure/symptoms after controls; no cancer endpoint.

records.allowed_inference: Document control-associated improvement in this workplace

records.cancer_evidence: OSHA warns some fumigants cause cancer; agent must be identified.
records.iowa_evidence: Industry present in Iowa; source is national guidance

records.allowed_inference: Inventory actual fumigant ingredients and historical use
records.prohibited_inference: Label all grain dust an established human carcinogen

records.cancer_evidence: Selected flour-worker cancer excesses; NHL uncertainty includes null.
records.iowa_evidence: Not Iowa-specific
records.limitations: Historical pesticide information; individual dose unavailable; all-cause mortality lower than reference. NHL CI from IARC assessment at https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK499667/ .
records.study_design: Mortality cohort plus nested case-control analyses
records.population_scope: United States American Federation of Grain Millers insured men
records.allowed_inference: Retain lower overall mortality and uncertain specific-site signals
records.prohibited_inference: Transfer old fumigant-era estimate to current Iowa feed mill without exposure matching

records.cancer_evidence: Overall cancer not elevated; liver-cancer signal.
records.iowa_evidence: Swedish study, not Iowa-specific
records.limitations: Geographic/historical exposure differences; contamination hypotheses not individual measured aflatoxin dose.
records.allowed_inference: Include null total-cancer and site-specific findings together
records.prohibited_inference: Attribute an Iowa cancer to mycotoxin without exposure evidence

records.cancer_evidence: Settlement is not a cancer determination.

records.agent: Process chemicals not speciated in identity record
records.cancer_evidence: Facility registry is not health evidence.
records.iowa_evidence: Port Neal Iowa facility identity in EPA FRS
records.limitations: FRS and DNR site IDs differ from Title V inventory facility IDs. Verify temporal aliases and location before joining.

records.cancer_evidence: NIOSH describes carcinogenic information as inconclusive; acute corrosive/respiratory hazards established.

records.cancer_evidence: Burn incident; not a cancer event.
